in_sanskrit.name: कर्षन
in_sanskrit.meaning: ददातुर् वा ददामी वा ददाति वा ददातु वा करोति वा कर्षणम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He who bestows, grants, gives, confers

in_hindi.name: कर्षण
in_hindi.meaning: देने वा प्रकाशित करने वा कराने वा करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who gives, reveals, or performs

in_marathi.name: Karshan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Karshan means 'Bringer of Joy'. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Karsh' meaning 'to reach', and 'Shan' meaning 'joy' or 'happiness'. The name is associated with the deity Lord Vishnu, who is believed to bring happiness and joy to his devotees.
